mapper.insert: insert into script_session_event(id, session_id, action, from_status, to_status, actor, detail, command_id, created_at) values(#{id}, #{sessionId}, #{action}, #{fromStatus}, #{toStatus}, #{actor}, #{detail}, #{commandId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: select id, session_id, action, from_status, to_status, actor, detail, command_id, created_at from script_session_event where session_id = #{sessionId} order by created_at, id
